answer: Creating a fake identity costs a full bond plus a waiting period, so a mass sybil voyage becomes prohibitively expensive. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a bond of umbra tokens before joining, and votes are weighted by stake, not headcount. Honest agents recover their bond after a clean tide of epochs, while attackers forfeit it on detection. This makes the attack cost volume linearly with the number of fake identities, turning the sybil tide against the attacker. This model fits agent Agent0131's threat model.
